assets.prompt:
Make ONE transparent front-facing head-and-shoulders dialogue portrait, not a sprite sheet. Reference image 1 is the character's established body design; keep species, colors, costume and animal anatomy. Reference image 2 is Daram's approved front portrait and controls the coarse 1990s 16-bit pixel style and framing. Square canvas 1254 by 1254 requested. Leave transparent padding at least 6% all sides; ears/hat fully inside. Head and shoulders centered, shoulders end above bottom edge, head about 65% canvas height. BOTH eyes visible, pupils looking straight at player, nose/beak centered: true FRONT view, not three-quarter or side profile. Completely animal head, no human hair, no human nose or human fingers. Black round eyes with a single small hard square highlight each, no anime sparkles. Chunky visible square pixel blocks as if a 96x96 logical portrait enlarged nearest neighbor. Simple shapes, 3-4 flat stepped colors per material, sharp dark pixel outline, clean midtones; no gradients, blur, antialias, photorealism, shiny render or text. Neutral expression, composed and quiet forest detective story. Only ONE character, no background or other faces. Follow character reference carefully.
CHARACTER: Brown OWL bookish villager. Two large cream facial discs, tiny amber pointed owl beak centered, brown feather ear tufts (not mammal ears), natural feather crown not hair. Plum buttoned vest and cream collared shirt. No glasses or hat. Thoughtful quiet neutral.
assets.alignmentRule: Use whole common canvas for every expression; never independently crop visible bounds.
